news.title: "Assurer la régularité des trains et préserver la biodiversité": SNCF Réseau teste un système d'effarouchement des animaux, pour éviter les collisions
news.summary: Les collisions de trains avec des animaux sauvages ont augmenté de 60% ces trois dernières années, notamment en raison de la prolifération incontrôlée des sangliers
news.credit_fr: D'après l'actualité du 11 octobre : "Assurer la régularité des trains et préserver la biodiversité": SNCF Réseau teste un système d'effarouchement des animaux, pour éviter les collisions (Franceinfo)
news.mechanic_fr: SNCF teste son dispositif d'effarouchement des animaux sur la ligne qui dessert Paris‑Est — les essais provoquent aujourd'hui des retards et quelques suppressions de trains.

pick.mechanic_fr: SNCF teste son dispositif d'effarouchement des animaux sur la ligne qui dessert Paris‑Est — les essais provoquent aujourd'hui des retards et quelques suppressions de trains.
pick.why: Train tests causing delays could strand the learner or change their return plans, directly affecting the succession timetable and the group's ability to meet.

draft.premise_fr: Margaux demande votre commande pour la troisième fois. Gus plaisante : votre commande dit qui vous êtes. Lila se moque et vous pousse à choisir. Le groupe attend votre réponse — et votre raison d'être encore ici.
draft.setup_native: Margaux asks your order again; Gus teases that your order reveals you. Choose your usual order and give a short reason why you are staying.
draft.objective_native: In French, say your usual order (a drink or pastry) and give a short reason why you are staying here.
draft.objective_semantics: Learner names one item to order (e.g. 'un café crème') and adds a brief reason with 'parce que' or 'pour' (one clause). This establishes the learner's 'usual order' and why they remain in Paris for the moment.
draft.causal_reason: Margaux has asked the learner’s order three times; the group treats orders as signals of belonging, so the learner's answer will create the usual order and a small shift in the group's view of them.

chapter.dramatic_question: Quelle commande deviendra la vôtre, et est-ce un geste qui dit que vous restez ici ?
possible_developments: The learner picks an order and explains a reason — the group accepts it and notes the new usual order.
Gus declares the learner un habitué and teases lovingly, changing how the group treats them.
Lila grades the choice and teases, creating a private bond; Margaux writes the order on the glass.
Romy hears and asks a follow-up question about Solvel, opening another thread.

panels.narration_fr: Le Mistral est réveillé. Gus fait une blague, Marin rit en soulevant sa cuillère.

dialogue.text_fr: Règle numéro un : une commande, c'est une identité.
dialogue.text_native: Rule number one: an order is an identity.

panels.visual_direction: Wide shot of the café: the worn zinc, the booth with Marin and Gus, Margaux behind the counter polishing a glass. Lila sits with a paint-stained shirt, leaning forward.
panels.alt_native: Wide view of the café interior with the cast at the counter and table.

panels.narration_fr: Lila note, avec sa voix d'enseignante critique.

dialogue.text_fr: Alors, tu as vraiment une habitude ?
dialogue.text_native: So, do you really have a habit?

dialogue.text_fr: Si vous choisissez bien, vous êtes un habitué. Choisissez bien.
dialogue.text_native: If you choose well, you are a regular. Choose well.

panels.visual_direction: Medium shot on Lila and Gus at the booth. Lila nudges the learner's empty cup on the table; Gus straightens a salt cellar.
panels.alt_native: Lila nudging the cup; Gus arranging the tableware.

panels.visual_direction: Close-up on Margaux at the counter, drying a glass and looking directly at the learner as she asks. The background shows a chalkboard menu.
panels.alt_native: Margaux at the counter looks at the learner and asks a short question.

panels.narration_fr: Le groupe attend votre réponse — et la petite vérité qui va avec.
panels.visual_direction: Medium shot including Margaux, Lila and Gus; they wait expectant. Romy leans on the counter with her recorder off, curious.
panels.alt_native: Group around the counter waiting; Romy asks a question while the recorder is off.

draft.suggested_response_fr: Je prends un café crème, parce que je reste ici quelques jours.
draft.hint_native: Say the item you want (drink or pastry) and a short reason with 'parce que' or 'pour'. Example: "Je prends un café, parce que je dois régler des papiers."

lexicon.gloss_native: order (what you ask for in a café)

season_checklist.change_after: A usual order is established and the group treats the learner as an habitué.
season_checklist.turn_want: Choose your order and say why you are staying (a short, honest reason).
season_checklist.hook_fr: À suivre… quelqu'un écrit votre commande sur le verre.

Give their lines to someone who is, or to narration: cast is ['augustin_de_roncourt', 'bastien_roux', 'camille_marchand', 'landlord_marchand', 'lila_bonnet', 'maitre_vasseur', 'margaux_barman', 'marin_leveque', 'mme_diallo', 'romy_tremblay']. The learner never has a dialogue line (their words are their reply), and a person who is only remembered or mentioned (Odile, a clerk) is spoken about, never given a line.
